name: intochat.ai
author: intochat

sections.description:
intoCHAT is a powerful platform that allows you to create, customize, and deploy AI-powered chatbots for your business or personal use. Our service combines cutting-edge AI technology with an intuitive interface, making it easy for anyone to build sophisticated chatbots without coding experience.

Easily embed intoCHAT chatbot as a floating bubble on your WordPress site.

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

External Services

This plugin connects to the intochat.ai service to embed chat functionality.

It loads a script from https://www.intochat.ai/api/embed.js to render the chat interface.

No personal data is sent automatically; the script is used purely for rendering the chat interface. Any data entered by users in the chat widget is processed according to intoCHAT’s privacy policy.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/intochat-ai-embed directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > intochat.ai to configure your chatbot ID.
  4. The chatbot will automatically appear as a floating bubble on all pages of your website.
sections.faq:
Where do I get my chatbot ID?

You can find your chatbot ID in your intoCHAT dashboard. Visit https://www.intochat.ai/ to learn more.

Can I customize where the chatbot appears?

Yes, you can choose to display the chatbot on all pages automatically, or use the shortcode [intochat] to embed it on specific pages.

What license is this plugin under?

This plugin is released under the GPLv2 or later license.
